The First-tier Tribunal's decision highlights crucial insights into property borders and emphasizes the importance of diligent title plan checks for prospective buyers to avoid future complications.

The planned divestiture could facilitate reinvestment in long-term goals, particularly in bolstering AI capabilities. Analysts express a positive outlook on future prospects within Accenture's extensive market presence.

title: 'Like a war movie': 4 killed, 19 critical after fire at Canada military base
content: four service members were killed in a fire that spread rapidly during a training exercise . at least 19 others have been hospitalized for serious injuries, including burns . dozens have to be treated for severe burns and are in critical condition .

title: Shinde meets Tiger Shroff after firing incident; pics show actor with bandages
content: deputy chief minister says five rounds were fired during the incident . he said the actor was safe . the actor had sustained injuries to his left hand due to gunpowder and glass shards . his driver sustained injuries, and the incident is condemnable .

title: Kenya reports 8th Ebola case as Congo outbreak expands across borders
content: a 49-year-old patient was identified as a contact of the country's first case . the outbreak in Congo spread to an eighth province, raising concerns over cross-border transmission across the region . a health official said the patient had cleaned utensils and linens and was probably exposed to the first case.

title: Espionage case on Army officer’s wife, lens on ‘China links’
content: the woman is from Telangana, works as a freelance researcher and had a UN internship in 2023 . she allegedly used AI tools ChatGPT and Claude to write papers on sensitive security issues for Chinese intelligence operatives suspected to have contacted her . the information was allegedly passed on through encrypted communication (online) mediums .

title: Woman killed, 3 injured as Russian attack hits Kyiv residential building, subway station
content: the attack hit a subway station on the city's left bank and damaged a 25-storey residential building . the attack comes amid ongoing efforts to secure a diplomatic settlement to the war, which began with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine .

title: US: Immigration dept returns Indian national to Oregon jail to face manslaughter trial
content: ICE says the move would allow state criminal proceedings to continue . the 32-year-old has been indicted on two counts of first-degree manslaughter and three counts of recklessly endangering another person . he has been transferred to state custody in Deschutes County, Oregon .

title: Putin proposes trilateral summit with Trump, Xi to discuss Ukraine war: Report
content: the three sides have yet to agree on the meeting or its agenda . a senior US official told the newspaper that Trump had not formally agreed to the summit but could be open to the proposal as he seeks to end thursday . the three parties acknowledge the hypothetical possibility of such a meeting taking place .

title: Japan’s MMX moon mission to launch on Oct 20, bring Phobos samples back by 2031
content: a japanese space mission is set to lift off on October 20 . if successful, the mission will mark the first time material from either of its moons has been brought back to Earth . the MMX spacecraft will study Phobos while travelling through the martian system before turning its attention to Phobos .

title: Aretha Franklin’s Detroit estate gets $2m restoration after years boarded up
content: aretha Franklin's estate sold for $300,000 before new owners began a $2 million restoration . the house witnessed the private life of Aretha, the queen of soul, and belonged to a chapter of the city's cultural history that risked fading away .

title: Milan on edge: Protesters clash with cops, smash windows; videos show chaos
content: demonstrators clash with police, smashed shop windows and looted stores . videos show tense scenes around the iconic Piazza del Duomo . the violence erupted during demonstrations against rising cost of living and deteriorating public services .

title: Phone on speaker in train? You may be fined, jailed
content: a nuisance in Metro rail also attracts a penalty and such persons can be removed from coaches . the move could bring relief to railway passengers disturbed by people playing music or watching videos on their phones . people persisting with such an act could even face up to six months of jail and up to Rs 5,000 penalty .

title: Almost a century after J&K HC was set up, Ladakh gets bench
content: the bench of ladakh HC will sit 3,500 metres above sea level . the bench will sit in leh, an altitude no other HC can ever match . HC came into existence on march 26, 1928, with three judges .

title: City halls torched, shops looted: France in shock after violent protest - videos
content: the scale of the unrest was visible in Paris on Sunday . shattered shopfronts, broken glass and dislodged cobblestones littered the area . around 5,50,000 people took part in the demonstrations, while organisers put the turnout at 8,00,000.

title: Amid ‘Leave India’ notice to nephew, Aamir Khan meets Raj Thackeray
content: actor and actor met MNS chief Raj Thackeray at his residence in dadar . the meeting created a buzz in political circles as it came amid his nephew, imran Khan, being issued a leave India notice following his brief detention from the site of a protest in the city on Oct 10 .
